About this item

  • 【2 Minutes Smart Timer】: The 2 Minutes Intelligent Timer offers an interval pause every 30 seconds to remind you to balance the four areas of your mouth and to reach dental professional recommended brushing time and habit. IPX7 waterproof for easy water rinsing after each use.
  • 【8 Brush Heads】: The bristles are made with dupont nylon which are soft, wear-resistant and non-absorbent, provide you a safe and gentle brushing experience. W-wave brush heads perfectly fit each tooth and better remove stains.
  • 【Efficient Oral Care】: This electric toothbrush for adults employs a powerful motor to achieve 31,000 vibrations per minute to help you keep a consistent and effective clean of your teeth and gums. Remove more plaque and stains compared to a regular manual toothbrush, improve gum health better than a manual toothbrush.
  • 【Hidden Charging Cable & Ergonomic Hand Grip】: The electric toothbrush is equipped with a hidden USB charging cable at the bottom of the toothbrush body, convenient to charge for all kind of charge block and avoid lost. Ergonomic hand grip is comfortable and non-slip. Fast charge Up to 30 days use (2 min/2x a day) on a full and fast charge of 2-hour.
  • 【5 Optional Modes】: Customized brushing experience with 5 modes based on your specific needs: Clean mode, Polish mode, Milder mode, White mode, Massage mode. 5 different modes fit for different conditions of teeth and gums and even take full care of your sensitive oral and teeth.

Product description

Sonic Electric Toothbrush - 4 colors optional

Main Features:

8 Dupont replaceable brush heads for 2 years to use

2 Hours fast charge, lasts up 30 Days

5 Optional Modes to meet all your daily cleaning needs

2 Minutes Smart Timer to encourage a healthy brushing habit

Hidden Charging Cable & Ergonomic Hand Grip

The electric toothbrush is equipped with a hidden USB charging cable at the bottom of the toothbrush body, convenient to charge for all kind of charge block and avoid lost. Fast charge Up to 45 days use (2 min/2x a day) on a full and fast charge of 2-hour.

8 x Replaceable Brush Heads for 2 Years to Use

Bristles: DuPont nylon

Wear-resistant and Non-absorbent

Vibration Intensity: 31000 stroke/min

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find this electric toothbrush to be the best one they've used, with great cleaning performance that leaves teeth feeling clean and comes with many extra brush heads. They appreciate the multiple settings and modes, and one customer mentions their teeth feel smooth after use. The battery life receives mixed feedback - while some say it stays charged for a long time, others report it doesn't charge at all. Durability is a concern as the toothbrush breaks after 6 months, and ease of use is mixed, with one customer noting the on/off switch is difficult to use.

    I am keeping it and hoping I get used to using it. But this toothbrush is MASSIVE! The handle is very long, and the power button is in the middle of the handle, so it turns off all the time when I am using it. Poor placement for a power button. Then there is the POWER of this thing. The first time I used it I literally thought there was no way I was going to be able tolerate it. But I used one of the other settings that was a little less dramatic for a few days and slowly worked my way up to the "cleaning" function. But it is still some crazy force that comes from this toothbrush. It does clean your teeth VERY well and I like that it is rechargeable. I charged about a week ago when it arrived and I have not had to charge it since. I like the pink color; it is not an eye sore sitting on the bathroom counter. I would say this is not a "travel" toothbrush. Again, it is oversized and while it comes with a cover for the head of the toothbrush that cover is not going to stay on in a travel bag. I will have to get a smaller battery operated one for travel. It seems durable and if you can get past how big it is and the massive power then you might love this toothbrush. I on the other hand.... am tolerating it for now until I can't and I will order something different.

  • Jamie Morgan
    5 out of 5 stars
    A brilliant and affordable upgrade!
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on December 12, 2025
    Color: Blue
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This Toothbrush is amazing. I've never been able to own a Toothbrush like this one. Coming from a certain OB type one its certainly refreshing to have a toothbrush that works in a completely different way and cleans even better than my old one ever did.

    It has a 'sonic' vibrating motor inside that is very powerful and moves the brush head considerably more than my old toothbrush so it can reach more area of the teeth and get into places your old one couldn't. The toothbrush has many settings, Clean, Polish, Milder, White and Massage (Each Setting Shown in the video).

    A con of the device would possibly be that even though it comes with a USB-C charger that it does in fact take 2 hours to fully charge, which if your in a hurry to get somewhere and it has died, you can bet you will be leaving the house without brushed teeth. However the pro fact here majorly outweighs the con, this is because the actual life of the battery is immense. When I purchased this product about a month ago, before writing this review, I have only charged it once and it still seems to have loads of power left. Once! A single charge in an entire month! In certainly did not expect this. This is absolutely amazing given that my last toothbrush had the life expectancy of a few days to a week. Even less as the old toothbrush was very old and I thought it was time for an upgrade, and you can bet, I got one!

    The actual brush head has lasted the entire month too. Its not warped in any particular way that makes it look old but in fact makes it still look brand new. (As shown in the video). This, coupled with the 8 extra brush heads leads to the conclusion that this toothbrush might last an entire year, or more, without having to pay any extra money for replacement brush heads, something which I found myself constantly doing with my old Toothbrush which in turn cost a lot of money just for the heads themselves.

    I also noticed that the toothbrush works and cleans your teeth even without Toothpaste, of course I only tried this as a one off experiment to see what all the fuss was about regarding the sonicare technology and to see if it genuinely cleared the plaque off my teeth and to my surprise, it did a good job. (This may not be the same result for everyone as this was only tried once, and not again, so please do not take my word for it.)

    All in all, I would say that this product is a very good one, its affordable, uses newer sonicare tech instead of a rotating brush head, saves you money in the long term and can last an entire month on a single charge! Id definitely recommend this product to anyone, especially someone like myself who needed an upgrade from an outdated one to a cheap affordable one that gets the job done and done well.

    Would definitely recommend. Thank you for reading.

    P.S. I would like to add, at this time of posting this review, I cannot upload any photos or videos due to a problem with my phone, however, I can assure that upon reading this review, you should be able to use the given information (and other information on reviews on this product) to be able to possibly make a good decision to upgrade to a brand new toothbrush that is definitely worth the upgrade. Thank you for reading.

About this Item

  • 【2 Minutes Smart Timer】: The 2 Minutes Intelligent Timer offers an interval pause every 30 seconds to remind you to balance the four areas of your mouth and to reach dental professional recommended brushing time and habit. IPX7 waterproof for easy water rinsing after each use.
  • 【8 Brush Heads】: The bristles are made with dupont nylon which are soft, wear-resistant and non-absorbent, provide you a safe and gentle brushing experience. W-wave brush heads perfectly fit each tooth and better remove stains.
  • 【Efficient Oral Care】: This electric toothbrush for adults employs a powerful motor to achieve 31,000 vibrations per minute to help you keep a consistent and effective clean of your teeth and gums. Remove more plaque and stains compared to a regular manual toothbrush, improve gum health better than a manual toothbrush.
  • 【Hidden Charging Cable & Ergonomic Hand Grip】: The electric toothbrush is equipped with a hidden USB charging cable at the bottom of the toothbrush body, convenient to charge for all kind of charge block and avoid lost. Ergonomic hand grip is comfortable and non-slip. Fast charge Up to 30 days use (2 min/2x a day) on a full and fast charge of 2-hour.
  • 【5 Optional Modes】: Customized brushing experience with 5 modes based on your specific needs: Clean mode, Polish mode, Milder mode, White mode, Massage mode. 5 different modes fit for different conditions of teeth and gums and even take full care of your sensitive oral and teeth.
